title: Reading in short bursts with little breaks
examples: Is it okay to take breaks when reading?
How long should I read for?

explain.say: Have you ever felt tired after reading for a long time? Your brain works really hard when you read. So here is a smart plan: read a little, then rest a little. Look at the board.

explain.say: First: read just one page. Not the whole book! One page is a small goal you can win. Which book would you like to try?

explain.say: Then: take a short break. Stretch your arms up high, drink some water, or wiggle your toes. A break is like charging your battery. What would you do in your break?

explain.say: You can use a timer too. Now: read until it rings. Next: stretch. Then read again. Little and often works really well for lots of people. How many minutes feels right for you?

explain.say: Look at the board: page, break, page, break. Before you know it, you have read lots! Brilliant planning. Your brain learns in its own way, and lots of brilliant people learn like this.

faq.q: How much should I read at once?
faq.a: Start small, like one page or five minutes. When that feels easy, you can read a little more.
asks: How long should I read for?

faq.q: What can I do in my break?
faq.a: Stretch, get a drink of water, look out of the window or wiggle about. Keep it short, then come back.
asks: What should I do in a reading break?

faq.a: Reading is hard work for your brain. A short rest helps you come back fresh and ready to focus again.
asks: Is it okay to take breaks?

faq.q: How do I use a timer for reading?
faq.a: Ask a grown-up to set a timer for a few minutes. Read until it rings, take a short break, then go again.

faq.q: What if I do not want to come back after a break?
faq.a: Plan a fun reward for the end, like a game or a snack. A teacher or grown-up can help you make a first-then card.
asks: I do not want to read again

facts: Short, spaced practice sessions often help people remember better than one long session.
A first-then board shows one task first and a break or reward after it.

quiz.say: What is a good first reading goal?
quiz.why: One page is a small goal you can win, then you take a break.

wrong.1: The whole book in one go is a lot. Start with one page.
wrong.2: Ten books is far too much at once. Start small.

quiz.say: What is a good thing to do in a reading break?
quiz.why: A short stretch and a drink charge you up, then you come back.

wrong.1: A long film is not a short break. Keep breaks short.
wrong.2: A break is short. After it, you come back and read again.
